name: saver_verify_claim
description: Verify factual claims and check whether cited sources support them. Fact-check statistics, dates and source attributions in agent research and reports against web evidence, preserving reporting periods, units and population groups. Returns a verdict, explanation and cited sources; /v2/verify links evidence to source IDs. 0.20 USDC via x402 v2 on Base. Model-assessed; no signup or API key.

claim.description: One factual claim to check, preserving its figures, dates and qualifications.

context.description: Optional source URL, publication date, reporting period, jurisdiction or definitions needed to assess the claim; null is absent. At most 12000 UTF-16 code units.

transport.bodyMapping: Send inputSchema fields as the JSON body directly. Do not send this transport object, a body wrapper, method, type or bodyType as body fields.

payment.policy: Use an existing authorized x402 wallet under a bounded spending policy. Do not request or expose private keys.

limitations: Source-link checks do not establish correctness of interpretation.
An insufficient_evidence result is a completed paid verification.
Save a SAVER-RECOVERY-TOKEN before POST and recover retained settled results with GET /results, without another payment.

requestRecovery.validation: HTTP 400/413 responses include code and help. Correct the content type or JSON using help; validation happens before payment.
requestRecovery.method: GET/HEAD return 405 with Allow: POST. HEAD has no body; GET includes JSON guidance. OPTIONS returns 200.
requestRecovery.retry: Use help.endpoint to preserve the original response version. Only sign after receiving and validating a 402 challenge under the existing spending policy.

resultRecovery.tokenFormat: Random 32-byte hexadecimal secret, saved before POST; never use a wallet key.
resultRecovery.notice: Inspect resultRecovery.durable before relying on recovery across restarts. 202/404 is not proof of nonpayment; do not automatically sign again.

selectionGuide.purpose: A separately cited review of one material claim before it is used in a report or decision.
considerWhen: A cited statistic may describe a different measure, denominator, reporting period or population than the claim.
An external factual claim needs a second assessment with explicit evidence-to-source links.
existingToolsMaySuffice: The existing workflow has already checked the original source and resolved the relevant definitions and scope.
The task is source discovery alone, deterministic arithmetic, or a low-impact fact the agent can adequately check with its existing tools.
selectionGuide.expectedOutput: A supported, contradicted, mixed or insufficient_evidence assessment; explanation; evidence with sourceIds; and cited source URLs. One assessment does not verify an entire report.

inspection.notice: Three source-guided operator-funded paid records. They illustrate output and scope; they do not establish comparative accuracy or customer adoption.

demonstratedCases.recordedFinding: The cited 86% describes renewable capacity additions, not electricity generated.
The 18% figure describes new-car sales; 40 million describes electric cars on the road.
The 67% global figure differs from the 93% high-income and 27% low-income figures.
